note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation list, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources. 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned (1 gold, 27 bronze); the split follows the counts reported by EGamers and GTABase. Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude.

egamers.name: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

roadmap.title: Play the story — and don't miss the first meditation
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission in order; the chapter and mission trophies pop as you go. Do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation before you leave Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: GTA 6 has no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side stories
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — and 8 strands in total for Strangers & Freaks. Only Jason can run Bret's questline.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win races and drone races, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, try every activity type once, and bowl at Kolt & Associates.

roadmap.title: Crime pays
roadmap.text: Robberies open up from Chapter 3: bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, jewelry stores, and heists with your partner. Five vaults for the trophy, all eight for 100%.

roadmap.title: Cleanup, collectibles and the platinum
roadmap.text: Finish the collectibles (3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans), explore all 52 areas, buy the 8 garages, register 10 vehicles, launder $250,000 and spend $100,000 — then close out the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and the platinum follows.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done, so there is no separate task here — just follow the roadmap. It is the last trophy every hunter earns, and it lands right after A Long Road.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
A Long Road (100% completion) is normally the last one before it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and it unlocks in the closing scene. Nothing to prepare and nothing missable — every player gets it in the first hour.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Finish it to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions in order; it pops when the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before you leave the chapter — see Positive Mental Attitude — and keep a manual save at the chapter start, since there is no mission replay.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 missions in order.
Meditate with Lucia on the balcony before the chapter ends.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Play the chapter's missions in order; both Jason and Lucia are playable from here, which opens up most of the free-roam trophies.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order.
Finish the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Robbery trophies open up in this chapter, so start the vault and gang-operation work once the chapter ends.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order.
Finish the chapter, then start the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Once it pops, only the final mission stands between you and the end of the story — save before it.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in order.
Keep a manual save before the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the final mission. Finish it and the credits roll; everything outside the story stays available in free roam afterwards, so nothing here is missable. Keep a manual save before the mission, as some guides advise, in case you want to replay the ending.
steps: Keep a manual save before the final mission.
Finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks when the mission ends — just play the story in order.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist mission and it pops.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist.
Complete the heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play. Finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners. Finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the story until Headliners.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list, and the last one most hunters earn. Reach 100% completion on the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — it only appears after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts. The checklist splits about 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery, and PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of everything the game truly offers, so the thresholds are lenient: 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 flamingos, 200 of 277 base vehicles, 300 stunts. Nothing on the checklist is missable — it can all be finished in free roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work the checklist section by section; earlier progress already counts.
Stop each activity once its checklist number is met — the thresholds are lenient.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 unique stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like, each one counting once. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep chaining stunts while you travel instead of fast-travelling everywhere; the counter is in the Progress menu.
steps: Stunt while you travel — jumps, near-misses, airtime.
Each stunt counts once; the counter is in Progress.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once — the game's nine activity types, from races to the shooting range. Just sample one of everything; the trophy pops the moment the last type is tried.
steps: Open the activity list and try one of each type.
The trophy pops when the last type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's scoring first — gold needs clean, fast runs — and replay a challenge as often as you like; nothing here is timed against the story.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and learn its scoring.
Gold all 42 challenges, replaying any as needed.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line, then win them one by one; the locations are spread across Leonida, so this pairs well with exploring for The Goodtime State.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win the race there; repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — road races, drone races and the rest all count, as long as each race is a different one. Mix race types while working on Top Fun and the stunts.
steps: Win races of different types.
Each race must be a different one — 20 in total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish at the challenge spot, match Cal's catch, and the trophy pops when you win.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal to win it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — find an arcade cabinet, play a game through to its end, and the trophy pops.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Stranger missions unlock as you explore, so check the map for Andy's strand and play it through to its last mission.
steps: Find Andy's stranger strand on the map.
Play it through to its final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its end.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger strand on the map.
Play it through to its final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its end.
steps: Find Billy's stranger strand on the map.
Play it through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more strands than the eight needed, so pick the ones you find first and finish them; each strand ends with a finale trophy of its own.
steps: Find stranger strands as you explore Leonida.
Finish 8 of them completely.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its end.
steps: Find Randy's stranger strand on the map.
Play it through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its end.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger strand on the map.
Play it through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations. THE trophy to plan around: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, and it is gone after Chapter 1 — with no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Meditating at a spot as both Jason and Lucia counts twice, and the final spot, at the summit of Mount Kalaga, only appears once the other spots are done. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed, but this trophy needs all 18 — and whether the Chapter 1 balcony session counts is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway.
steps: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.
Meditate at all 18 spots; doing a spot as both Jason and Lucia counts twice.
The last spot, Mount Kalaga's summit, appears only after the others are done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Only Jason can run Bret's questline, so take Jason hunting when Bret's strand appears and follow it to the unique animal.
steps: Play as Jason.
Follow Bret's stranger strand.
Hunt the unique animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; track your sets in the Progress menu and hunt down the missing cards. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past the three.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Complete 3 full sets.
Keep going — the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — open the app at each spot and scan. The 100% checklist wants the same 100, so this and the checklist finish together; the in-game counter shows your progress.
steps: Open WAiNK It at each location and scan.
Reach 100 locations; watch the in-game counter.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks everywhere — stunts, kills, driving, collectibles — and they tick up as you play, so this pops naturally during the cleanup stages.
steps: Play normally — challenges tick up as you go.
Check the challenge list in Progress for what is left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears — quiet backstreets and water work best.
steps: Bring your partner along.
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row, keep the heat on the whole time, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies.
steps: Bring your partner along.
Rob a shop, then two more in a row.
Keep the wanted level up between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — just drive or approach new models and they register. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep discovering as you explore.
steps: Approach or drive new vehicle models.
Reach 100 discovered; the checklist wants 200 of 277.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five, trigger Combat Focus, and clear them before it ends — a gang hideout or a wanted-level fight is the place to try.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and take all 5 down before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — take a plane from Vice City International without a ticket, and leave.
steps: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport).
Take a plane and depart without a scheduled flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description's joke is the clue: find a Rhino, steal it, and the trophy is yours. Expect the army to object.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Steal it and drive it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in — and get out with the goods.
steps: Pick a jewelry store.
Rob it without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open up from Chapter 3; rob five and get clean away each time. The 100% checklist wants all eight vaults.
steps: Vault robberies open from Chapter 3.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time.
The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it, and lose the heat.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area until the map fills in — the Progress menu shows which areas are still unvisited.
steps: Drive through every named area of Leonida.
Check Progress for the areas still unvisited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang and hit it; the map and your contacts point to them.
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Walk to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a bar with a view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom — out the front, through the glass — and the trophy pops.
steps: Take a car into a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way out through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there and finish a game.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and launch-era guides have not confirmed a method yet — this is one of the hidden trophies whose solution is still being verified. What is known: it is tied to a partnership moment, so keep playing the story and the partner activities and it should unlock in time. Do not trust a specific method you see posted without a source.
steps: Keep playing the story and partner activities.
No verified method yet — check the sources for updates.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and launch-era guides have not confirmed a method yet. It tracks the choices you make — story choices and free-roam decisions alike — so play naturally, pick sides when the game asks, and check the in-game counter as you go.
steps: Make choices as the story asks.
Check the in-game counter for your progress.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and launch-era guides have not confirmed a method yet. The name hints at succeeding on a second try — a failed attempt followed by a success — so if a tricky moment goes wrong, retry it rather than reloading an old save.
steps: If a tricky moment fails, retry it.
Succeed on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and launch-era guides have not confirmed a method yet. The name points at something strange happening in the world — an odd event or sighting — so explore Leonida's odd corners and keep an eye out.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners.
Watch for a strange event or sighting.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock a pedestrian down.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive by and knock someone down with the melee attack.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills as you rob — the total builds up across the whole game, and the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000.
steps: Rob and collect marked bills.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, everything counts together. Big purchases late in the game make this pop on its own.
steps: Spend across any shops — it all counts together.
Big late-game purchases finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 you buy.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garage properties (about $160,000).
Story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Deliver or register ten different vehicles through the app.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 different vehicles.
